name: Custom Shape 2-Layer Wooden And Acrylic Suncatcher Wind Chime With Crystal Charm
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from a combination of wood and premium acrylic, creating a beautiful layered decorative effect.
    - 2-layer structure includes:
                     +) Layer 1: Acrylic – 3 mm thickness – 1-sided printing.
                     +) Layer 2: Wooden base – 3 mm thickness – 1-sided printing.
    - Wooden frame enhances durability while adding a warm decorative touch.
    - The wind chime also features:
                     +) Crystal charm (round or heart shape) for sparkling light reflections.
                     +) Aluminum tubes that produce soft and relaxing chime sounds.
                     +) Durable nylon ropes and hanging strings for secure installation.
                     +) Wooden top base that supports the wind chime structure.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Suncatcher Size Options:
                     +) 3 x 3 in ~7.62 x 7.62 cm.
                     +) 4 x 4 in ~10.16 x 10.16 cm.
                     +) 5 x 5 in ~12.7 x 12.7 cm.
    - Total hanging length of wind chime: 58 cm
    - Diameter of top wooden base: 10.5 cm
    - Crystal charm size: 3 cm
    - Diameter of each metal tube: 1.5 cm.
    📌 Note: The suncatcher ornament dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses advanced UV printing technology to produce vivid colors and sharp details.
    - Printing is applied directly onto the acrylic and wooden surfaces for long-lasting durability and fade resistance.
    - 1-sided printing on each layer ensures clear artwork while maintaining the natural material appearance.
    - High-quality finishing enhances both visual clarity and surface protection.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Decorative wind chime and suncatcher ornament that combines visual beauty with calming sound.
    - Crystal charm reflects sunlight, creating sparkling light effects in natural light.
    - Aluminum tubes generate gentle and relaxing chime sounds when moved by the wind.
    - Ideal for decorating gardens, patios, balconies, windows, porches, or indoor spaces.
    - Adds a peaceful and elegant atmosphere to both indoor and outdoor environments.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful decorative gift for family members, friends, or loved ones.
    - Perfect for Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, birthdays, anniversaries, memorial gifts, or housewarming celebrations.
    - Ideal for those who enjoy personalized décor, wind chimes, and meaningful keepsakes.
    - Combines artistic design, soothing sound, and sentimental value, making it a memorable gift for any special occasion.🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x Custom Shape 2-Layer Wooden And Acrylic Suncatcher Wind Chime With Crystal Charm

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
